name: web-orange-and-teal-illustrated-desert-404-scene
title: Illustrated desert landscape in pink, orange and indigo with sandy '404' numerals
whatItIs: A soft 3D-style illustration of sand dunes with orange rock pots, spiky indigo plants, a green bush, cacti with pink flowers and a fence, and the numerals '404' formed in sand across the middle.
whatItMeans: Warm and quirky; a tumbleweed-quiet desert makes an error page feel like a place.
techniques: Form the error number from sand or terrain.
Fill the whole frame with the scene.
